topperMethod.proTip: Never write down decimal rounded figures on the rough sheet. Do direct mental fraction evaluation.

question:
I. x² − 17x + 72 = 0
II. y² − 19y + 90 = 0
options: x = y or relationship cannot be established

standardMethod.title: Standard Method (Factoring & 4-Way Comparison)
steps: Equation I: Factors of 72 adding to 17 are 9 and 8 → roots x = +9, +8
Equation II: Factors of 90 adding to 19 are 10 and 9 → roots y = +10, +9
Since x is either smaller than or equal to y in all comparisons: x ≤ y.

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (Factor Visualization & Bound Compare)
steps: Both equations have (-, +) signs ⇒ All roots of x and y are positive (+, +)
Notice max(x) = 9 which equals min(y) = 9, and all other x < y.
topperMethod.proTip: When roots share an exact boundary number (here 9), check whether the ranges overlap or merely touch. Here they touch at 9, hence ≤.

question:
I. x² + 13x − 68 = 0
II. y² − 7y − 60 = 0
options: x = y or relationship cannot be established (CND)

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (The 3-Second CND Sign Rule)
steps: Look at the constant terms: -68 in I, -60 in II.
RULE: When both constant terms are negative, both equations MUST have one positive and one negative root.
A pair of (+, -) roots against another (+, -) roots ALWAYS results in CND / No Relation!
Mark option 5 in 2 seconds without touching the pen.
topperMethod.proTip: Look at the signs before even reading the numbers! If both constants are negative, you just earned a free mark in 2 seconds.

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (Instant Cube Differences)
steps: Diffs: +1, +8, +27, +64 → Instantly recognize sequence of cubes: 1³, 2³, 3³, 4³
Last digit check: 4 + 5 = 9. Only 239 ends in 9!
topperMethod.proTip: Combine series pattern recognition with last-digit addition to eliminate having to do the full sum.

question: A shopkeeper marks an article 40% above its cost price and allows a discount of 20% on the marked price. If he earns a profit of ₹180, find the cost price of the article.
questionHi: एक दुकानदार एक वस्तु का मूल्य उसके क्रय मूल्य से 40% अधिक अंकित करता है और अंकित मूल्य पर 20% की छूट देता है। यदि वह ₹180 का लाभ कमाता है, तो वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (Successive Percentage Formula)
topperMethod.proTip: Markup (+a) followed by discount (-b) is simply successive percentage: Net% = a - b - ab/100.

question: The difference between simple interest and compound interest compounded annually on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 15% per annum is ₹270. Find the sum.
questionHi: किसी धनराशि पर 15% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्ष के लिए साधारण ब्याज और वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज के बीच का अंतर ₹270 है। वह धनराशि ज्ञात कीजिए।

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (Direct 2-Year Difference Formula)
topperMethod.proTip: Simplify the fraction (15/100 = 3/20) before squaring to get (9/400). 270 cancels directly with 9 to give 30.

question: A alone can complete a piece of work in 24 days, and B alone can complete the same work in 36 days. They work together for 6 days, and then A leaves. In how many days will B finish the remaining work?
questionHi: A अकेले किसी काम को 24 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है और B अकेले उसी काम को 36 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। वे 6 दिनों तक एक साथ काम करते हैं, और फिर A काम छोड़ देता है। B शेष काम को कितने दिनों में पूरा करेगा?

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (Total Work = LCM Units)
topperMethod.proTip: Integer units turn fraction subtractions into elementary mental subtraction: 72 - 30 = 42, then 42 / 2 = 21.

question: In what ratio must a grocer mix two varieties of pulses costing ₹45 per kg and ₹70 per kg respectively, so as to get a mixture worth ₹55 per kg?
questionHi: एक पंसारी को ₹45 प्रति किग्रा और ₹70 प्रति किग्रा वाली दो किस्मों की दालों को किस अनुपात में मिलाना चाहिए, ताकि ₹55 प्रति किग्रा मूल्य का मिश्रण प्राप्त हो सके?

standardMethod.title: Standard Method (Algebraic)
steps: Let x kg of first pulse and y kg of second pulse be mixed.

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (Alligation Cross)
topperMethod.proTip: Draw the cross in your head. 70-55=15 on the left, 55-45=10 on the right. 15:10 reduces to 3:2.

question: The difference between compound interest and simple interest on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 12% per annum is ₹144. Find the principal sum.
questionHi: किसी धनराशि पर 12% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्ष के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज का अंतर ₹144 है। मूलधन ज्ञात कीजिए।

topperMethod.title: M. Tyra's Quicker Formula
steps: 144 cancels out with 144 on both sides!
topperMethod.proTip: M. Tyra Rule: For 2-year CI-SI difference, P = Diff × (100 / R)². When Diff = R², P is always 10,000!

question: Two trains of length 140 m and 160 m are running in opposite directions on parallel tracks at speeds of 42 km/h and 30 km/h respectively. In what time will they cross each other completely?
questionHi: 140 मीटर और 160 मीटर लंबाई वाली दो रेलगाड़ियाँ समानांतर पटरियों पर विपरीत दिशाओं में क्रमशः 42 किमी/घंटा और 30 किमी/घंटा की गति से चल रही हैं। वे एक दूसरे को कितने समय में पार करेंगी?

standardMethod.title: Standard Method (Step-by-Step Conversion)
steps: Convert speeds separately: S1 = 42 × 5/18 = 35/3 m/s; S2 = 30 × 5/18 = 25/3 m/s

topperMethod.title: M. Tyra's Single-Line Crossing Formula
steps: Instant km/h to m/s: 72 is (18 × 4) → 4 × 5 = 20 m/s!
topperMethod.proTip: Remember the 18:5 benchmark table. 18 km/h = 5 m/s, 36 = 10 m/s, 54 = 15 m/s, 72 = 20 m/s, 90 = 25 m/s.

question: A trader has 50 kg of rice. He sells a part of it at 14% profit and the rest at 6% loss, gaining 4% overall on the whole transaction. How much rice did he sell at 14% profit?
questionHi: एक व्यापारी के पास 50 किग्रा चावल है। वह इसका एक हिस्सा 14% लाभ पर और शेष 6% हानि पर बेचता है, जिससे पूरे सौदे में उसे 4% का समग्र लाभ होता है। उसने 14% लाभ पर कितना चावल बेचा?

standardMethod.title: Standard Method (Algebraic)
steps: Let x kg be sold at 14% profit and (50 − x) kg at 6% loss.

topperMethod.title: M. Tyra's Alligation Cross (Signed Values)
steps: Quantity at 14% profit = 50 × (1/2) = 25 kg in 4 seconds!
topperMethod.proTip: Alligation handles losses seamlessly with negative signs: 4 - (-6) = 10. The 1:1 ratio splits 50 kg into 25 kg each.

topperMethod.title: Rajesh Verma's Base & Duplex Squares
topperMethod.proTip: Base 50 mental rule computes 74², 36², and 48² without writing intermediate products on scratch paper.

question: The length of a rectangular plot is increased by 30% while its breadth is decreased by 20%. What is the net percentage change in the area of the plot?
questionHi: एक आयताकार भूखंड की लंबाई में 30% की वृद्धि की जाती है जबकि इसकी चौड़ाई में 20% की कमी की जाती है। भूखंड के क्षेत्रफल में शुद्ध प्रतिशत परिवर्तन क्या है?

topperMethod.title: Rajesh Verma's Fast Track Net Change Formula
topperMethod.proTip: When signs are opposite (+A, -B), formula is directly (A - B) - (AB/100).

question: What is the unit digit in the product: (2467)¹⁵³ × (341)⁷² ?
questionHi: (2467)¹⁵³ × (341)⁷² के गुणनफल में इकाई का अंक क्या है?

standardMethod.title: Standard Method
steps: Unit digit of 2467 is 7. Cyclicity of 7 is 4.
Unit digit of 341 is 1. Power of 1 always yields 1.

topperMethod.title: R.S. Aggarwal's Cyclicity Reflex
topperMethod.proTip: To find power mod 4, you only need to divide the LAST TWO DIGITS of the exponent (53 mod 4 = 1).

topperMethod.title: R.S. Aggarwal's Algebraic Identity Recognition
steps: Notice algebraic form: (a³ + b³) / (a² − ab + b²)
Since a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²), the expression simplifies to (a + b)!
topperMethod.proTip: Bank exams constantly test (a³ + b³)/(a²-ab+b²) = a+b and (a³ - b³)/(a²+ab+b²) = a-b. Never calculate cubes!

question:
In the following question, two equations are given. You have to solve both equations and give answer:
I. x² + 7x − 60 = 0
II. y² − 11y − 80 = 0
questionHi:
निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में दो समीकरण दिए गए हैं। आपको दोनों समीकरणों को हल करना है और उत्तर देना है:
I. x² + 7x − 60 = 0
II. y² − 11y − 80 = 0

standardMethod.title: Standard Method (Full Factorization)
steps: Hence, no relation can be established.

topperMethod.title: Shantanu Shukla's 2-Second CND Sign Rule
steps: Look directly at the constant terms of both equations: c1 = −60 and c2 = −80.
Golden Banking Rule: When both constant terms are negative, both equations produce one positive and one negative root.
One positive and one negative root in both equations ALWAYS overlap.
Select 'Relationship cannot be established' in 2 seconds flat!
topperMethod.proTip: Whenever both equations end in - c = 0, do not pick up your pen! Mark CND instantly.

topperMethod.title: Shantanu Shukla's Split & Interchange Hack
topperMethod.proTip: 250% is 5/2, so 84 × 5/2 = 42 × 5 = 210. 2.5% is 1/40, so 640/40 = 16. Both parts solve in under 4 seconds.

question: A sum of ₹16,200 is invested at compound interest at 16 2/3% per annum for 3 years, compounded annually. What is the total compound interest earned?

topperMethod.proTip: The ratio 6³ : 7³ gives 127 units of CI directly. Multiplying 127 × 75 mentally as 12700 - 3175 eliminates long division.

question: A shopkeeper marks his goods 40% above the cost price and allows a discount of 25% on the marked price. If he makes a profit of ₹240, find the cost price of the article.
questionHi: एक दुकानदार अपनी वस्तुओं पर क्रय मूल्य से 40% अधिक मूल्य अंकित करता है और अंकित मूल्य पर 25% की छूट देता है। यदि वह ₹240 का लाभ कमाता है, तो वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।

question: A container contains 80 litres of pure milk. 8 litres of milk is taken out and replaced with water. This process is repeated 2 more times (total 3 times). How much pure milk is left in the container?
questionHi: एक बर्तन में 80 लीटर शुद्ध दूध है। इसमें से 8 लीटर दूध निकालकर उसके स्थान पर पानी मिला दिया जाता है। यह प्रक्रिया 2 बार और दोहराई जाती है (कुल 3 बार)। बर्तन में अब कितना शुद्ध दूध शेष है?

standardMethod.title: Standard Method (Step-by-Step Calculation)
steps: Round 2: 8L mixture removed contains 8 × (72/80) = 7.2L milk. Milk left = 72 − 7.2 = 64.8L.
Round 3: 8L mixture removed contains 8 × (64.8/80) = 6.48L milk. Milk left = 64.8 − 6.48 = 58.32L.

topperMethod.title: Sumit Sir's Power Ratio Replacement Formula
steps: Cube of 9 is 729; 8 × 729 = 5832 done in 8 seconds!
topperMethod.proTip: Always use Formula: Q_final = Q_initial × (1 - y/x)ⁿ. Cubes of 9 (729) and 8 (512) are critical for 3-cycle replacements.
